items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Ray used to play there many times.

ctx.x: That’s what — I think it was Ray Drummond was telling me that.

That’s right. Ray used to play there many times. And I think when Paul Desmond passed away he willed Bradley his piano. They had this beautiful Baldwin grand. And Bradley was like an amateur pianist. But in the will it said the only way he’s getting the piano is if he puts it in the club and not his apartment. ©Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
